meta.title: Full list of requirements extracted verbatim from the prompt
meta.policy: Every requirement below is traced to the instruction text. Status is measured against the repository state on main at e8d04a9.

requirements.text: Collect, organize, and analyze utilizing a full list of requirements
requirements.evidence: Catalog exists in data/derived/manifest.json and verification; this new hub adds a formal requirements matrix with source trace.

requirements.text: Make suggestions on how to improve site to improve decision making and create section dedicated for suggestions so someone can review suggestions and choose best path before implementing any changes
requirements.evidence: New suggestions/pages/suggestions.html implements a proposal queue with priority, ownership, and review gate — no auto-merge.

requirements.text: Provide clear list of questions, informations and answers that need to be addressed before any decision can be reasonably made based upon info we already have and do not have; suggestions to discover missing info
requirements.evidence: New pages/questions.html and pages/decisions.html organize Have / Don't Have / How to get it, with every row sourced.

requirements.text: Originate own NFL lines (spread, total, moneyline, player-prop lines) from official play-by-play feed
requirements.evidence: scripts/build_site.py + data/derived/model.json: weighted point-ratings model, walk-forward 2023-2026, spread MAE 10.39 pts vs market 10.25, total MAE 13.2 residual SD, slope 1.05.

requirements.text: Research and develop strategies for generating useful signals — treat as leaderboard competition providing rewards for top performing strategies
requirements.evidence: 7 candidate strategies + 2 controls gated through 10 gates; 0 approved; leaderboard reward tiers documented (Tier1 10/10, Tier2 8-9/10).

requirements.text: Look at single bet, parlays, player prop bet combos
requirements.evidence: Families covered: S1-S2 single spread edges, S3-S6 situational singles, S7 wind-under total, 4-leg same-team parlay economics, player-prop calibration (9 props).

requirements.text: Each strategy must pass validation gates
requirements.evidence: 10 gates G1-G10 defined (point-in-time integrity, sample size, out-of-sample, FDR, positive lower bound, stability, beats closing line, luck-adjusted, executable, reproducible). All 7 fail ≥5 gates.
QB→WR1 r=0.562 (n=7560), WR1↔WR2 r=0.12, home-cover vs over φ=0.016; 4-leg joint 11.1% vs product 5.7%. Measured via NIST Pearson formula.

requirements.text: Remove luck from equation and build strategies that are selectively skill based
requirements.evidence: Luck decomposition: Pythagorean R²=0.819, SD 1.32 wins luck, y-o-y r=0.024 (p=0.49); one-score y-o-y r=0.082; strategies fail luck-adjusted gate.

requirements.text: System should track injuries and know deficiencies in defenses (2nd/3rd/4th string backups replacing starters due to lineups), same for offenses (starters vs backups)
requirements.evidence: No live tracker exists; injury-policy content URL returns 404, roster pages exist but depth-chart order previously flagged. This hub publishes a concrete tracking schema using official injury-hub daily reports and official team depth charts.

requirements.text: Create executive summary outlining important details
requirements.evidence: Existing pages/executive.html plus new suggestions/pages/executive.html summarize bottom-line, verification, and open risks. Rewritten here with explicit source trace.

requirements.text: No manual input — work on own to finish all tasks; work line by line, verify everything from official verified trusted sources, no hallucinations
requirements.evidence: Site generated from committed JSON only; verification/recompute.py independenty recomputes 49 checks with 45 pass, 0 fail.

requirements.text: Repo work: review repo line by line verifying from official verified trusted sources, provide links for manual review, flag irregularities, no hallucinations
requirements.evidence: data/derived/verification.json (49 checks) + pages/flagged.html (15 items) + new suggestions/pages/flagged.html; every row carries source link.

requirements.text: Site creation: GitHub Pages live site with clean landing page and subpages organized by category, clean user-friendly simple dashboard, all entries in simple easy-to-read table format, include analysis and findings, work line by line, verify everything
requirements.evidence: Root index.html + 14 pages + 71 sibling pages all link-checked (0 broken, 221 tables, 3348 links). New suggestions/ hub adds 12 more pages in same style.
